I need to implement `cappedRunningTotal` in JavaScript. It will compute a running total of the input array, but cap each cumulative sum at the given limit. Once the running total reaches or exceeds the cap, all subsequent positions will be fixed at that maximum value.

I drafted a loop-based implementation using a `capped` flag. I also considered a simpler version using `Math.min(total + num, cap)` to enforce the limit directly.

I confirmed the `Math.min` approach is equivalent. Once the running total hits the cap, adding any non-negative number keeps it capped, so the logic is correct and cleaner.
